description: brainstorm-toolkit — surface the .next-action seam + keep long loops context-cheap. Two Stop hooks. next-action.sh surfaces /brainstorm handoffs, /sdlc-lite --queue park-resumes, and gotcha seams as `Next: …` (and, with pipeline.auto_continue, drives the loop). The SessionStart hook (matcher compact|clear) reseeds a pointer to the loop's durable on-disk state after a compaction/clear, so aggressive auto-compaction stays lossless for the orchestrator. Merges with any user/project hooks (deduped by command). `run-cost-report.sh` fires once per run, when a pipeline envelope reaches a terminal status (complete/failed/paused): it reads the hook's own transcript_path and prints turns, average context, peak, cache-read and rough spend. It is emitted as `systemMessage`, so it reaches the HUMAN watching the terminal and never enters the model's context -- that is what makes it free, and it is also why it is only seen if someone is looking (never switch it to hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext). It never blocks and never resets (no tool can force /clear or /compact). Silence it with project.json pipeline.context.cost_report set to off. The earlier mid-run threshold nag and its pipeline.context.warn_above_tokens knob were removed -- see docs/LOOP-HYGIENE.md for why a lagging mid-run warning was the wrong shape. See docs/SEAM.md and docs/LOOP-HYGIENE.md.
